title: The Protocol of Station Meridian
author: Cyrus Delacroix
blurb: Lior Voss, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
